| Quest Stages | 
|---|
| Stage | Status | Description | Log Entry | 
| ? | | Go to Van Lowe Taxidermy | I've found a poster left by someone claiming that the "Sheepsquatch" ate their brother. It said I should go to Van Lowe Taxidermy in Lewisburg for more information. | 
| ? | | Retrieve a Holotape from the box | I've arrived at Van Lowe Taxidermy after following directions on a poster claiming that a "Sheepsquatch" ate their brother. There's a sign here directing me to take something from a box. I should probably do that if I want to find out what's going on. | 
| ? | | Listen to Wanted: Sheepsquatch from your inventory | | 
| ? | | Go to Calvin van Lowe's office | Shelley van Lowe has requested that I help find information on her missing brother, Calvin. She requested I start by going to the office on the 3rd floor. | 
| ? | | Search the office terminal for clues | | 
| ? | | Find Calvin's Security Code | In order to find more information on Calvin van Lowe, I'll need access a restricted part of his terminal. I should search the building for a security code-- there may be clues to help me find it hidden through out the house. | 
| ? | | Find the letter to Wolf | | 
| ? | | Investigate the display case | | 
| ? | | Find a use for the Strange Bone | I've found a strange bone. It has strange markings on it, along with a label that says "Wolf Side". I should see if there if there is something in Van Lowe Taxidermy that it can fit into. | 
| ? | | Read Calvin's Security Code | | 
| ? | | Access the Research section of Calvin's terminal | I've retrieved the security code by placing the strange bone into a mounted wolf head. I can now use the security code on the terminal in Calvin's office to find out more about what he was up to. | 
| ? | | Find where Calvin went next | | 
| ? | | (Optional) Find all clues in Van Lowe Taxidermy (#/#) | | 
| ? | ![Quest finished Quest finished](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a9/FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png/15px-FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png) | (Quest completed) | |
